Revenue grew 44% to ₹2,013.15 crore. The communication segment saw a surge in EBIT to ₹52.52 crore, aided by favorable inventory pricing and export growth to the US and Europe. Conversely, the copper rod plant remained shut due to LPG shortages. Management accelerated capex plans, aiming to expand fiber draw capacity to 8 million km by September 2026 to capitalize on global fiber demand
